sentences.en: Jackson grinned wickedly and caught her by the waist.

sentences.en: Juicy Couture bags feature flaunty designs for all sorts of wickedly girlish activities.

sentences.en: Our Verdict... Ali G has etched himself into superstardom and Sacha Baron Cohen excels in this wickedly funny compilation.

sentences.en: Both are wickedly humorous yet disturbing tales in which laughter seems to well up and then freeze in one's throat.

sentences.en: Beautiful styles from classic courts in duchesse satin to wickedly sexy lace-up boots.

sentences.en: His satirical sideswipe at white, middle class, suburban America was wickedly funny, fantastically well observed and perfectly cast.

sentences.en: Take the time to try a new activity, indulge in an hour of unadulterated relaxation, or sample a wickedly decadent dessert.

sentences.en: With the many sites that offer wickedly funny cards, you're sure to find the perfect "bad" card for a good laugh.

sentences.en: She immediately understood where his mind had gone and chuckled wickedly.
